While Borís remarks that "Natálya Ilyníchna behaves very well to me" [[cite:C2:S10]], this occurs immediately after Véra mentions "Mamma" [[cite:C2:S9]], and the context specifies that both the mother and the youngest daughter of the Rostóvs are named Nataly [[cite:C0:S1, C1:S4]], indicating that Natálya Ilyníchna is the mother.

The Rostóvs' name day is St. Natalia's day [[cite:C1:S4]], which is celebrated by both the mother and the youngest daughter [[cite:C0:S1, C1:S4]].
